name: The Haymaker
description: A spinning welcome committee. Four brick-built hammers make the space beneath this ceiling trap a very bad place to stand.
alt: Concept art of the Haymaker, a hanging rotating shaft with four wooden hammer heads in a brick castle.

name: Spike Trap
description: Simple. Pointy. Persuasive. Build a lane that brings the crowd right across a nasty surprise underfoot.
alt: Concept art of a brick-built floor trap with a bed of raised spikes.

name: Arrow Wall
description: Put those castle walls to work. A volley across the lane gives incoming creatures another reason to regret their route.
alt: Concept art of a castle wall fitted with a grid of arrow launchers.

name: Gargoyle
description: Stone wings. Heavy hands. This flying bruiser sails over your floor traps before dropping into a two-handed slam.
alt: Concept art of a grey brick minifigure Gargoyle with horns and wide bat wings.

name: Werewolf Hunter
description: The crystal can wait. This quick, clawed hunter is much more interested in the hero running around beside it.
alt: Concept art of a grey brick minifigure Werewolf with a wolf head and clawed hands.

name: Skeleton Squad
description: The portal's regulars arrive in packs. Turn their march into a trap-filled obstacle course, then help send them back in pieces.
alt: Concept art of a skeleton emerging from a glowing purple portal in a brick castle gateway.
